Block bootstrap for Hawkes MLE confidence intervals

Source: R/block_bootstrap.R
block_bootstrap.Rd

Block bootstrap for Hawkes MLE confidence intervals

Usage

block_bootstrap(
  hawkes,
  est,
  B,
  num_blocks,
  alpha = 0.05,
  parallel = FALSE,
  max_iters = 500,
  boundary = NULL
)

Arguments

hawkes

A hawkes object.

est

A hawkes_est object containing parameter estimates for hawkes.

B

Number of bootstrap iterations.

num_blocks

Number of blocks sampled during each bootstrap iteration.

alpha

Type I error rate for the confidence intervals. Defaults to 0.05.

parallel

Logical flag for furrr based parallel computation.

max_iters

Maximum EM iterations per fit. Defaults to 500.

boundary

Optional boundary width used for edge correction.

Value

A tibble of bootstrap estimates.

Examples

params <- list(
  background_rate = list(intercept = -4.5, z = 1),
  triggering_rate = 0.5,
  spatial = list(mean = 0, sd = 0.75),
  temporal = list(rate = 2),
  fixed = list(spatial = "mean")
)
data("example_background_covariates")
hawkes <- rHawkes(
  params,
  c(0, 50),
  example_background_covariates,
  covariate_columns = "z",
  spatial_burnin = 1
)
est <- hawkes_mle(hawkes, inits = params, boundary = 1)

block_bootstrap(
  hawkes,
  est,
  B = 2,
  #B = 1000,
  num_blocks = 25,
  alpha = 0.05,
  parallel = FALSE,
  boundary = 1
)
